fusions.name: Three on the String
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shot at Full Sprint
fusions.desc: Looses one arrow that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Nock, Step, Loose
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 9 seconds, and you finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Bodkin Velocity
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
